test_title: PYST 40: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Some people are in the habit of sharing _______ and bull story on unsuitable occasions.
solution:
The correct answer is- **"cock"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"cock"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The phrase a** cock-and-bull story** is an idiomatic expression that refers to a story or explanation which is obviously not true.
 
 
• **Example: **He gave me some **cock-and-bull story** about having to be at his cousin's engagement party.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 3)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of some more phrases.
